name: dsh-review-graph
description: Review a change set as a relationship graph in the middle column, with every node clickable to the exact source line.

meta.title: Review Graph
meta.description: Turn this turn's changed files into a clickable relationship graph.

author: huaxiaolong <https://github.com/huaxiaolong>

scripts.test: node test/selftest.mjs && node test/git-scopes.mjs && node test/host-routes.mjs && node test/diff-parse.mjs && node test/flow-parse.mjs
scripts.verify: node build-vendor.mjs && node build-client.mjs && npm test
scripts.verify:offline: node build-vendor.mjs --offline && node build-client.mjs && npm test
